# MailFn

> Programmable inboxes, MIME evidence, scoped access, testing, and agent workflows.

## Documentation

- [Administration capability](/docs/administration) — Understand MailFn's Super Console resource and action contract.
- [CLI and MCP](/docs/cli-and-mcp) — Operate inboxes with sanitized CLI output and narrow agent tools.
- [Cloudflare runtime](/docs/cloudflare-runtime) — Provision Email Routing, D1, R2, Queues, and Worker handlers.
- [Core and storage](/docs/core-and-storage) — Embed the provider-neutral service and supply durable adapters.
- [Credentials and scope](/docs/credentials-and-scope) — Use one-time inbox credentials and narrow API permissions.
- [Getting started](/docs/getting-started) — Create a scoped inbox, wait for mail, and extract a verification value.
- [MailFn](/docs) — Programmable inboxes with durable MIME evidence and scoped APIs.
- [Messages and evidence](/docs/messages-and-evidence) — Understand raw MIME, normalized messages, attachments, and retention.
- [Operations and limits](/docs/operations-and-limits) — Release gate, retention, production flags, and live-service proof.
- [Outbound through SendFn](/docs/outbound) — Compose drafts, replies, and forwards with a delivery adapter.
